import funcy

# R3: memoize and cache with skip, .memory, .invalidate, .invalidate_all
print('=== R3 ===')
print('memoize.skip:', hasattr(funcy.memoize, 'skip'))
print('cache.skip:', hasattr(funcy.cache, 'skip'))
m = funcy.memoize(lambda x: x*2)
print('memoize.memory:', hasattr(m, 'memory'))
c = funcy.cache(1)(lambda x: x*2)  # cache needs timeout arg
print('cache.memory:', hasattr(c, 'memory'))
print('memoize.invalidate:', hasattr(m, 'invalidate'))
print('cache.invalidate:', hasattr(c, 'invalidate'))
print('memoize.invalidate_all:', hasattr(m, 'invalidate_all'))
print('cache.invalidate_all:', hasattr(c, 'invalidate_all'))

# Test invalidate works
m(1)
m(2)
print('Before invalidate:', len(m.memory))
m.invalidate(1)
print('After invalidate(1):', len(m.memory))
m.invalidate_all()
print('After invalidate_all():', len(m.memory))
